newsitem.title: USA: Plains feedlot cattle sales light at $69 - trade.
newsitem.headline: Plains feedlot cattle sales light at $69 - trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains direct cattle trade was slow near midday with lower-quality animals lightly trading at $69.00 per cwt, cattle feeders said.
But the sources still expect the bulk of Thursday's sales to come later at $70.00.
About 200 to 400 head lower-grade cattle sold in Kansas at $68.50 to $69.00 and about 1,200 sold in the Texas Panhandle and Western Oklahoma areas at $69.00.
"There will be trade today, and it will be at $70.00," one Kansas feedlot operator said.
Cattle prices were seen being lifted by higher boxed beef prices this week and tight supplies of ready cattle.
Boxed beef prices were rebounding following the Labor Day holiday weekend, which reportedly saw very strong beef clearance.
The strong demand depleted retailer stocks and resulted in active fill-in buying, market sources said.
